estimation.weight_rule: Weight = MLT/200 when NSC > NSS; otherwise MLT/100
estimation.missing_weight_policy: Fail/flag record; never silently replace with 1

stock_kpis.reason: Assets/liabilities are estimated as on 30-06-2002; stock reconstruction is based on Visit-1 information.

full_year_flow_kpis.reason: The two visits supply the two half-year portions required for 01-07-2002 to 30-06-2003 flow estimates.
full_year_flow_kpis.aggregation: Aggregate visit-specific flow facts to PANEL_HHID, then estimate once per household using one household Weight.

panel_key.name: PANEL_HHID
panel_key.derivation: Remove the 8th character (1-based) from the 10-character visit-specific HHID.
panel_key.validation: Each PANEL_HHID must have exactly Visit_no 1 and Visit_no 2.

cultivator.official_definition: Household operated at least 0.002 hectare for agricultural activities during the last 365 days.

non_cultivator.rule: B3_q8 < 0.002 hectares or no operated land

rural.important_note: Do not substitute household-type code B3_q4=4 for the official cultivator definition.

self_employed.description: Major source of household income during last 365 days was self-employment.

others.description: Regular wage/salary, casual labour, and other households.

geography.policy: Use NSS 59th Round / survey-era geography. Do not remap observations to present-day states or districts.
geography.name_mapping: Build/use a 2003 survey-era state/district codebook; preserve original codes in final output.

assets.block14_treatment: Loans receivable are assets. Never include Block 14 in household payable debt.
assets.valuation_principle: Use official as-on-30-06-2002 values where directly supplied; otherwise reconstruct the 30-06-2002 stock from schedule-prescribed stock/transaction fields.
assets.household_total_asset_value: Sum all non-overlapping physical and financial asset components at household level before weighting.
assets.ava: Weighted mean household total asset value = sum(Weight*HH_asset_value)/sum(Weight).
assets.gini_asset: Client-derived weighted Gini of household total asset value; disclose as derived, not an official published NSS statistic unless independently matched to a publication.
assets.asset_deciles: Client-derived weighted deciles of household total asset value; do not confuse with published asset-holding classes.

debt.core_debt_definition: Cash loans payable outstanding as on 30-06-2002.
debt.indebted_household_rule: Household is indebted when summed B15_2_q24 cash-loan debt > 0.
debt.block16_policy: Kind loans and other liabilities are not included in the core AOD/IOI/DAR cash-debt metric; retain separately if a client output explicitly requires them.

labels.03: Commercial bank including regional rural bank

capital_expenditure.source: Visit 1 & 2 Combined Blocks 17 and 18 with schedule-specific item coding
capital_expenditure.fce_definition: Fixed capital expenditure: purchase/construction/additions/alterations/improvements/major repairs of fixed assets, including eligible home-produced inputs and household labour, following the schedule/report rules.
capital_expenditure.epl_definition: Expenditure on purchase of land; keep separate from fixed capital expenditure where the official report does so.
capital_expenditure.normal_repairs: Recurring normal repairs/maintenance are tracked separately and must not be mixed into FCE unless the official table definition explicitly requires them.

debt_2002.usage: Validation controls for Step 04; allow only explainable publication-rounding differences.

documented_client_limitations.detail: 2003 credit-agency code 03 combines commercial banks including RRBs. Do not fabricate separate SCB and RRB estimates from this field.
Credit-agency code 02 combines co-operative society and co-operative bank in the schedule classification.

The available person-level Block 4 does not directly provide individual bank-account ownership. Do not manufacture total/male/female adult bank-account indicators without an independently supported variable or external source.
Code 07 is officially labelled financial company. If presented as NBFC, label the transformation/disclosure explicitly rather than silently renaming the category.

pipeline_invariants: Aggregate one-to-many fact blocks to household level before joining to the household base.
Never multiply household Weight by the number of asset/loan/item rows.
Use raw HHID for joins within a single visit and PANEL_HHID for cross-visit joins.
For paired-flow estimates, use one household Weight after visit-level facts have been consolidated to PANEL_HHID.
Preserve 2003 State/District codes alongside mapped names.
Do not reuse NSS 77th Round variable formulas or geography mappings unless independently proven identical for NSS 59th Round.
